archive.reconstruct: Concatenate parts in order, verify SHA256, extract into a fresh directory.
archive.timing_scope: Compression and full byte readback; excludes scanning, splitting and Git publication.

reproduction: Exclusive-create stages have completed; do not replay paid calls. Exact dataset, splits, programs, native results, responses, reviews, zero-API preflight, historical branch visibility check and actual test invocation failures are retained. Offline audit scores saved predictions. New trials require new directories and cumulative budget coverage. Source checks are review aids, not sandboxes.
runtime_scope: Base commit/clean metadata copied from previous delivery. New paired-program context, failed-program repair and narrow syntax allowances were uncommitted when frozen; exact experimental bytes are recorded independently in plan.frozen_files.
scope: One A/B pair per model on public hourly bicycle rentals with future-period confirmation and observed weather. B pairs recent/last-valid/leader programs with execution findings; A shows latest findings and leader source. Both allow exact edits and the same syntax. Full requested/resolved source, failures, diagnoses and actual predictions retained. One city and six final months do not establish general researcher ability or operational forecasting. UCI source is CC BY4.0; attribution retained in source.json.
